resources.string: Connection status
Your phone connects to the PC bridge. The game adapter, sensor receivers and individual sensors have separate states. A connected PC does not mean every sensor is ready.
PC address
Enter the address and port shown by the bridge on your PC. Both devices must be on a network that lets them reach each other. The PC may use Ethernet. A guest Wi-Fi network may block the connection.
Pairing code
Enter the current code displayed on the PC after verifying its identity. The code links this phone to that bridge. Request a new code on the PC if it expires.
Verify your PC
Compare the bridge identity shown on your PC with the one on this phone. Do not accept an unexpected identity change. A familiar IP address alone does not identify the PC.
Local network access
Allow access so the app can reach the PC on your local network. If access is denied, connection controls remain unavailable. You can keep reading help and change this permission in Android settings.
Waiting for fresh data
The last game update is too old to use safely. Values may remain visible with their age, but controls are unavailable until fresh data arrives. This does not stop the ride on the PC.
Version compatibility
Controls are available only when the bridge can verify them for the installed mod version. A version change may require an adapter update on the PC. Unavailable options explain their current limits.
Activate GTBike V
Starts the mod\'s sensor connection flow. Readiness can take a moment and depends on the PC receivers and devices. The app shows the observed state after the request.
Deactivate GTBike V

Stops the mod\'s receivers and multiplayer connection. The mod also attempts to save the current activity. This is different from saving an activity while keeping the mod active; check the resulting FIT file.
Browse routes
Previous and Next change the route you are previewing. Browsing does not start that route. The active route remains shown separately until you apply a selection.
Preview on PC

Opens the route selector in the game (if it is closed) and moves it to this route, so you can see its map and profile on the PC. It does not apply the route: use Apply route for that. Moving the selector on the PC replaces this preview.
Apply route

Loads the chosen route in GTBike V. The game may move your rider, save the previous activity, reset totals, create route bots and turn on autopilot. Stop before applying. With a workout in progress, the app warns you first: as in the mod menu, that workout starts again from its countdown on the new route.
Loop route
Repeats the route after a lap when the route supports looping. This option appears only for compatible routes. It is applied with the route selection.
Reverse route
Uses the opposite direction for a compatible route. GTBike V\'s selector exposes this option for loop routes. It is applied with the route selection and may reset when another route is previewed.
Free ride
Clears the selected course so you can ride without following that course. It is a route selection change, not an instruction to pause, save or turn off the mod.
Route profile
Shows the elevation profile and map supplied or generated for the route. Distance and elevation may update as route data finishes loading. Missing images do not mean the route has no hills.
Autopilot
Lets GTBike V steer along its current route or destination while your sensor data controls movement. Applying a course can turn it on automatically. Availability depends on the current game state.
Avoid obstacles
Changes the mod\'s obstacle-avoidance behaviour. The native menu disables this option while autopilot is on. It is a game assistance setting, not a guarantee that collisions cannot happen.
Rider weight
Your weight is used by the mod\'s riding simulation. Enter 40–150 kg, or the equivalent displayed unit. Existing activity calculations may retain the profile captured when that activity began.
FTP

Functional Threshold Power is a rider profile reference used for training zones and statistics. Enter 50–500 W. Changing it does not request a fixed power from the trainer. An existing activity may retain its starting reference.
Maximum heart rate
Used as a reference for the mod\'s heart-rate zones. Enter 50–220 bpm. This is a profile value; changing it does not change or calibrate the heart-rate sensor.
Bicycle
Chooses one of the bicycles available in this mod installation. Applying it changes the in-game bicycle, not just the name in a settings file. Stop before changing it.
Rider character
Changes the player model to an option provided by the mod. The available list comes from the PC. Apply while stopped and when the game allows player changes.
Trainer difficulty

Scales uphill simulation sent to a compatible trainer. Lower percentages make uphill resistance changes smaller. This is not an overall fitness level or a power target. Disabled is a separate mod setting, not the same as 0%.
Road Feel

Enables surface feedback when the PC\'s connected trainer supports it. The mod applies it only in supported riding modes and conditions. Saving the setting does not prove that the hardware can produce the feedback.
Virtual gears

Chooses a gearing mode supported by the mod and connected hardware. Native mode requires compatible hardware. This companion does not send workout power adjustments; gear-key shortcuts during a workout are unavailable.
PC sensor sources
These are devices used by GTBike V on the PC, grouped by function. A device may serve more than one function. Your phone does not need to connect to those sensors over Bluetooth.
Automatic source
Clears the fixed source and exclusions for this function so GTBike V can choose an eligible source again. It can change which device supplies this reading.
Lock current device

Keeps the currently identified device as the selected source for this function. If it disappears, the reading may be unavailable instead of switching automatically. Choose Auto to clear the fixed policy.
Skip current device

Excludes the current source for this function and lets the PC seek another eligible source. It does not guarantee that another device is available. A locked source must be returned to Auto before this action is available.
ANT+ and Bluetooth
The label shows how the PC receives this sensor\'s data. Receiver readiness and sensor presence are different. Use the PC\'s compatible receiver and the mod\'s device configuration to troubleshoot.
No sensor data
No valid reading is available for this function. Check that the sensor is awake and the PC receiver is ready. The app shows a dash for missing data; zero is reserved for a valid zero reading.
Find sensors with the phone

The phone only listens to Bluetooth sensor announcements; it never connects to them, so the sensor stays free for the PC. When you choose one, GTBike V on the PC locks that sensor for the function and connects to it directly, so riding data does not pass through the phone. The PC must also be within Bluetooth range. ANT+ sensors cannot be found this way.
Nearby devices permission

Needed only to list Bluetooth sensors around you. On Android 12 and later the app declares that it does not use it to find your location. Android 11 and earlier require the location permission for any Bluetooth search. The rest of the app works without it.
Disconnect a sensor

GTBike V on the PC closes its Bluetooth link to this sensor and stops using it. Functions pinned to it go back to Auto. Until you connect a sensor of that kind again from this screen, or deactivate and reactivate GTBike V, the PC does not reconnect to any sensor of that kind. Riding data never goes through the phone.
Waiting for the PC

The PC already saved the sensor for this function but has not connected yet. Wake the sensor (pedal, or wear and moisten a chest strap) and keep it near the PC. If the PC still uses another sensor of the same kind, turn that one off.
Training library
Browse plans and workout details available on the PC. Open a workout to see its segments and reference power; you can start it from there.
Select and start

Starts this workout on the PC exactly as its Select button in GTBike V does. The mod then puts the trainer in ERG: the resistance follows the workout\'s power targets (calculated with your FTP). If another workout is running on the PC, the app warns you first: it ends and is replaced, as when you choose a workout in the mod menu (it is not saved as finished; the activity goes on). Pausing, skipping and ending a workout stay on the PC.
Workout progress
Shows the workout and interval currently running on the PC. Intervals can use time or distance. This screen observes progress and does not pause, skip, end or change the workout.
Workout reference
Watts and cadence shown in the workout describe its reference values. They are information from the PC, not editable trainer commands. Your measured power and cadence appear separately.
Finish and save activity

Asks the mod to save the current activity and start fresh activity totals while keeping the mod active. Stop first. GTBike V saves only after more than 100 m. This action is unavailable during an unfinished PC workout, and success is confirmed only after the FIT is available.
Save result not confirmed
The connection ended before the result was known. The activity may already have been saved. Refresh the PC state and activity list before sending another save request.
Power
Shows the power reported by GTBike V in watts. A missing reading is different from a valid zero. The displayed value is measured data, not a power setting.
Cadence
Shows the pedalling rate reported by the PC, in revolutions per minute. A missing source is shown as a dash. Workout reference cadence is displayed separately from your measured cadence.
Heart rate

Shows the valid pulse reading received by GTBike V from the PC\'s selected sensor. A connected receiver alone does not guarantee a pulse reading. Check the Heart rate device role if no value is available.
Speed source
GTBike V can use sensor speed or a virtual speed calculated by the mod. The source is shown when known. This is your in-game riding speed, not your phone\'s physical speed.
Ride time
Counts time since the mod\'s current ride counters started or reset. It is different from moving time. Saving an activity or changing a route can reset these counters.
Moving time
Counts time that the activity records as moving. It may be shorter than ride time. This value comes from the current activity when available.
Elevation and gradient
Ascent is the accumulated climbing in the activity. Gradient describes the current slope. They are different measurements and may have different availability.
PC activities
Lists completed FIT files from the PC\'s Activities folder. Route reference FIT files are not your activity history. The PC must be reachable to fetch files that have not been downloaded.
Download FIT
Copies the selected completed activity to your phone so you can save or share it. It does not delete the PC file or finish the current ride.
Available statistics

The summary shows values available from the saved activity or a verified PC summary. Older FIT files may lack some values. Missing statistics are left unavailable rather than estimated from your current profile.
Power chart
Shows valid power records from this activity. Gaps mean data is missing. A chart based on FIT records can use different averaging from the mod\'s summary; the source is identified.
Training zones

Zones depend on the profile reference used for that activity. Historical zones are shown only when the required reference or verified summary is available. Changing today\'s FTP does not rewrite old activity data.
Game map
Shows the GTA world and available in-game rider position. It does not track your phone\'s location. If the map or its calibration is unavailable, use the dashboard and route details instead.
Riders and ranking
Shows riders and bots known to the PC\'s multiplayer session. Availability depends on that session and server. This connection is separate from your phone\'s link to the PC.
Join busiest route
Asks the mod to join the route with the most connected riders. You must first leave your current route. This does not select a specific rider or send an invitation.
Route bots
Controls supported bot definitions used when the mod creates a route group. These bots are different from ambient traffic cyclists. A saved change may apply only when the next group is created.
Traffic cyclists

Configures the mod\'s replacement of some traffic vehicles with bicycles and its supported behaviour presets. It is not a general traffic-density control. Some changes require the game script to reload.
When a change applies

Saved means the value is stored. Active means its effect has been confirmed for the current game state. Some settings apply to the next activity or route, or after a script reload; the option shows which one.
App language

The app uses your phone\'s language when it is English or Spanish, and English otherwise. You can choose English or Spanish for this app. This does not change GTA V\'s language or translate route names supplied by their authors.
Appearance
Choose a light theme, a dark theme or the phone\'s system theme. This changes only the companion\'s appearance and does not change graphics or brightness in GTA V.
Display units
Chooses the units used on this phone. The app converts values for display and sends settings in the units required by the bridge. It does not change GTA V\'s own measurement setting.
Keep screen on
Keeps the display awake while the ride screen is visible. It stops applying when you leave the screen or put the app in the background.
Disconnect this phone
Revokes this phone\'s access to the PC bridge and removes its saved credentials. It does not deactivate GTBike V or stop the ride on the PC.
Connection diagnostics
Shows which part of the connection needs attention and the installed versions. Copying a diagnostic report omits access tokens and unnecessary personal data. It does not send logs to anyone.
